title: Road Hazard Protection — Certificate Price Schedule by Plan
content:
**Schedule A. Price per tire and purchase window.** A Road Hazard Protection certificate is priced per covered tire as a percentage of the covered tire set's unit price, rounded half up to the cent, then raised to the plan's minimum or lowered to the plan's maximum when it falls outside them. The certificate covers the whole set: it is always sold on every tire of the covered set's ticket, and the price per tire is multiplied by the number of tires covered.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Price per tire, percent of the set's unit price | 12% | 15% | 17% | 20% | 22% | 18% |
| Minimum price per tire | 11.99 USD | 14.99 USD | 17.99 USD | 21.99 USD | 24.99 USD | 19.99 USD |
| Maximum price per tire | 29.99 USD | 39.99 USD | 44.99 USD | 54.99 USD | 64.99 USD | 49.99 USD |
| Rounding of the percentage price | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent |
| Price multiplied by | tires covered | tires covered | tires covered | tires covered | tires covered | tires covered |
| Whole set only | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Purchase window, calendar days after the set's purchase | 0 (same ticket only) | 0 (same ticket only) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 0 (same ticket only) |

A purchase window of 0 means the certificate can be sold only on the same ticket as the tires; a window of 30 means it can still be sold up to 30 calendar days after the covered set's purchase date.

**Worked figures (hypothetical unit prices).**

| Plan | Hypothetical unit price | Percentage price | Price per tire after minimum and maximum |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24-Month | 80.00 | 15% of 80.00 is 12.00 | raised to the minimum, 14.99 |
| 24-Month | 200.00 | 15% of 200.00 is 30.00 | 30.00, inside both limits |
| 24-Month | 300.00 | 15% of 300.00 is 45.00 | lowered to the maximum, 39.99 |
| 36-Month | 123.45 | 17% of 123.45 is 20.9865, rounded to 20.99 | 20.99 |

With four tires covered, a hypothetical price per tire of 30.00 gives a certificate price of 120.00.
